    #    This means we change the school affiliation of a student.
    #    If we move a non-chosen student (who is currently the strongest in a school) out,

    #    
    #    So the problem is: We want to select a set of students to move to new schools such that:

    #        There is only one strongest student per school. If we move m, the next strongest in s[c] becomes the new strongest.

    #

    #    If we move the current max, we save 1 move for that student IF they were the only obstacle.

    #    For example: 100 (A), 90 (B, chosen), 80 (C, chosen).
    #    Move A: B selected. C not. Move C. Total 2.
    #    Move B, C: Total 2.
    #    Move A, B: B selected in new school? No, if we move B to new school, B is selected. A is moved. C is not selected in old school. Need to move C. Total 3.

    #    So the cost is the same.

    #    B is not strongest. Move B to new school. Cost 1. B selected.

    #    Alternative: Move A (100). Now 90 (B) is strongest. B selected.
